summary: The verification record names the gate it reopened (cinatra#4312). Adds nullable artifact_verification_records.reopened_gate_id (FK to artifact_review_gates, ON DELETE SET NULL), written in the transaction that inserts the reopen gate, and read as the proof that a verification-reopen gate joins a repair lineage. A one-time backfill names the gate in the record's slot on the same run and organization, created at or after the record. Fresh-install bootstrap twin in lifecycleInterceptionsSchemaQueries.
